column3: Collect: name, phone, email, office_location, current_location, preferred_area, budget_min, budget_max, room_type
Lowercase all text. Strip punctuation. Expand abbreviations (HSR→HSR Layout, BLR→Bangalore, etc.). Remove trailing/leading spaces
Fuzzy match office_location text against tech_parks canonical names using token-set ratio (RapidFuzz / fuzzywuzzy). Score ≥ 75 = match. Get (lat, lng) of matched park
Fuzzy match preferred_area / current_location against alias dictionary first (exact+fuzzy). Then against sub_localities canonical names. Confidence score with each match
From matched canonical area → look up PIN code. Attach zone classification (South/North/East etc.)
Query pre-computed distance matrix: dist(office_lat,office_lng → preferred_area_lat,lng). If not pre-computed, use Haversine formula in real-time
For matched area lat/lng, compute distance to all metro stations. Return nearest operational metro station name + distance + line + status
Filter available PG listings by budget_min ≤ rent ≤ budget_max AND area = matched_canonical_area AND room_type = preferred_type
Rank results by: (1) Distance to office ≤ 5km, (2) Distance to metro ≤ 1.5km, (3) Budget fit, (4) PG rating. Return top 5 options
If office not matched: ask user to clarify. If area not matched with score ≥ 60: return top-3 closest area suggestions. If no PGs in budget: expand budget ±20% and flag
